name: FuxiBench
changelog: 2026-06-16: Audited and synced — 86 scenarios (67A+19B), fixed metadata, added labels, fixed benign-heavy-build
v1.2.0-eval: Revised 37 GT behaviors to align with collector observation granularity (network-exfiltration, cross-agent-delegation, etc.)
v1.2.0-eval: Added engine_section_json and signal_json to alert findings extraction
v1.2.0-eval: Relaxed severity gate in evaluator v2.1; behavior recall 0.717→1.000 (113/113)
v1.1.0: Fixed is_noise_process agent filter — subagent boundaries now detected for short-lived tmux-live agents
v1.1.0: Added metadata-based process tree fallback for evidence correlation (is_descendant_or_same_via_metadata)
v1.1.0: Enhanced behavioral scoring — 6-dim combinatorial gate with ToolCall+IntentCausesAction normalization
v1.1.0: Added transitive boundary closure sweep for deep nested subagent detection
v1.1.0: Lowered behavioral bypass threshold 0.40→0.30, Critical 0.65→0.55
v1.1.0: Added continuous scoring floor for sub-threshold behavioral activity
v1.1.0-final: 67/67 paper_ready after GT v2 promotion and replacement trace adjudication.
v1.1.0-final: Type A/B/C execution issues resolved or adjudicated in quality manifest; no samples excluded from FuxiBench main evaluation.
v1.1.0-eval: Fixed non-circular GT v3 evaluation with multi-behavior annotations (annotators: 刘周康, 唐浩钺, 刘锦样)
v1.1.0-eval: Added bootstrap 95% CI for behavior recall
v1.1.0-eval: Fixed detection FP counting structural bug in evaluator_v2
v1.1.0-eval: Added signal_json column to all 69 DBs
v1.1.0-eval: Enriched 53 single-behavior GTs to 2-3 behaviors each
v1.1.0-eval: Created 6 new Type B challenge scenarios (pending traces)
v1.1.0-eval: Created GT v3 for 14 previously unannotated scenarios (pending traces)

exclusion_reasons.description: No samples are excluded from FuxiBench main evaluation. Earlier refused or filtered candidates were hardened, rerun, or adjudicated before GT v2 promotion.
